title: A headless claude or opencode session out of usage hands off to the next account
description: Real dispatch with stub runtimes that exit at once on their provider's limit: claude's headless result "Switch to another model, or manage usage credits at https://claude.ai/settings/usage", OpenCode's Z.AI error {"type":"provider.quota","message":"Weekly/Monthly Limit Exhausted. Your limit will reset at …","status":429} from a worker (bare, and nested in its JSON error event with the 429 code 1310 body, as the worker run prints it) naming a reset a day ahead, and one naming a reset two hours behind the clock, as in the incident that filed this — and a reviewer. Each account is held (the Z.AI one until the UTC instant its own notice's Beijing wall clock names), the work starts on another account, and no launch failure is recorded; a notice whose reset has passed keeps that named reset on the exhaustion record.
